Medicine MBChB at University of Leeds

What University of Leeds asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Leeds courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 8 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma (living in the US): the standard academic requirement is the diploma with a minimum 3.0 GPA, two Honors classes at A+ to B, and at least one further qualification (AP at 4–5, IB HL course, dual-enrolment course, or a pre-2021 SAT II) — the SAT/ACT is not listed as part of it
  • SAT 1290 (650 Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, 620 Maths) or ACT 26 in English is accepted as evidence of English language ability

University-wide guidance on Leeds’ admissions-qualifications page for the USA (undated, current); it is not specific to this course.

  • IELTS: 7.5 overall with no less than 7.5 in Spoken English (other tests: Leeds’ English language equivalent qualifications)

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (US High School Diploma applicants): for an AAA offer, the diploma with 3.0 GPA, two Honors classes at A, plus one AP at 5 (an AP may replace an Honors class, e.g. three APs)
  • Subject-specific requirements (Chemistry and Biology) must be met with APs (or IB HL courses)

Leeds’ university-wide table for US qualifications; the course page gives no AP detail.

Verified19 Oct 2026Leeds: Admissions qualifications – United States of America
Other requirements
  • Points-based shortlisting for interview: top eight GCSEs, top three predicted grades, overall UCAT score and contextual information
  • Multiple mini-interviews for 2027 entry on 4–6 January 2027 (in person; overseas applicants online)
  • Enhanced DBS check and occupational health clearance required
  • Clinical work experience is not generally required
